products.name: Windows Updates for Business — Commercial
products.short_description: Take control of Windows patching with phased update rings, a pinned feature version, and a zero-day expedite button. Deploy it yourself with self-guided, tested steps for a fraction of consulting cost.
products.description:
Patched, predictable devices — without the surprise reboots and version drift

Unpatched devices are how breaches start; uncontrolled updates are how productivity dies. Windows Update for Business, managed through Microsoft Intune, replaces WSUS and guesswork with update rings: a phased, scheduled rollout of quality and feature updates, a one-click way to expedite zero-day fixes, and clear compliance reporting across every device.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant on site to take control of Windows updates. This package hands you the exact, field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation that a non-expert administrator can follow from start to finish — backed by ready-to-run PowerShell scripts that do the heavy lifting. You implement with confidence, on your own schedule, and keep the playbook forever.

  • Simpler — exact navigation in the right order, written for a novice admin. Click to implement; the “why” lives in the overview so the steps stay short and uncluttered.
  • Cheaper — one fixed, transparent price instead of an open meter. A comparable consulting engagement runs $1,500–$3,000 per day across several days; this is a fraction of that, with nothing left to bill.
  • Tested — a pilot-first, ring-based method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with validation scripts and clear pass/fail gates, so a bad update is caught on the pilot — never the fleet.

What's inside

  • Solution Overview — update rings, feature updates, expedited updates, and Delivery Optimization in plain language.
  • Requirements Guide — every prerequisite with how to verify and implement if missing.
  • Implementation Guide — exact, ordered Intune steps: Pilot + Broad rings, feature update profile, expedite, and Delivery Optimization.
  • 5 PowerShell scripts — update-status discovery, ring validation, fleet compliance reporting (Microsoft Graph), safe remediation, and ring/assignment auditing.
  • Testing & Troubleshooting Guides with pass/fail gates, plus Best Practices.

The Phoenixtekk way

Every Phoenixtekk solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each one you deploy feels familiar and low-risk — and your team gets faster and more confident with every rollout. Buy once, deploy to unlimited devices, and reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

A patched, predictable, reportable fleet: phased ring rollout that catches bad updates on the pilot, a pinned feature version that stops drift, a zero-day expedite button, and bandwidth-friendly delivery — deployable by a single administrator and validated before you expand.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • PowerShell Scripts (ZIP) — 5 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • WUFB-ComplianceReport.ps1 — fleet-wide update status + OS-build inventory (Microsoft Graph)
    • WUFB-Discovery.ps1 — Windows Update for Business readiness and current update posture
    • WUFB-Remediation.ps1 — force a policy sync and a Windows Update scan
    • WUFB-RingReport.ps1 — list Intune update rings + feature update profiles and assignments (Graph)
    • WUFB-Validation.ps1 — confirm an Intune update ring policy has applied to this device

Delivered as a branded Word document and PDF, plus all five PowerShell scripts in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse across unlimited devices.
